sourceAliases.note: No WooCommerce plugin profile authored yet for an Amazon channel plugin; this alias is a forward-pointer. Confidence is low because of the unresolved history noted in pitfalls.

preferredWrite.surface: Manual -- no API; merchant connects/creates an Amazon Seller account via the Wix dashboard

pitfalls.summary: Public support docs describe the original "Amazon by Wix" app as deprecated, with Wix recommending a third-party replacement. A newer internal service, wix.stores_channels.amazon.v1.amazon_passive_feed, implements an automatic AMAZON_XML feed push to an Amazon-owned S3 bucket. The current merchant onboarding path is not independently verified; re-verify whether the dashboard's Amazon entry uses this service or a third-party app before relying on the steps below.

evidence.path: wix.stores_channels.amazon.v1.amazon_passive_feed — PushAmazonFeed; feed built via wix.stores_channels.feed.v1.catalog's AMAZON_XML format — verified via docs-schema MCP, 2026-08-16 (created 2026-06-17, post-dating the public deprecation notice)

steps.text: Go to Catalog > Sales Channels > Amazon in the Wix dashboard and follow Connect/Setup to link (or create) an Amazon Seller account.
Publish Wix products to Amazon, or link existing Amazon listings back to their Wix product counterparts, per the dashboard flow.

manualSteps.mechanism: Believed push-based because the internal service builds a feed and pushes it to an Amazon-owned S3 bucket, but the current onboarding path remains unverified; see the amazon-integration-history-unclear pitfall.
